title: Clean design and practical patterns — Module Quiz
description: Course assessment: An order service chooses a pricing policy without a growing conditional.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: Which pattern fits interchangeable pricing algorithms?
questions.explanation: Strategy encapsulates a family of replaceable behaviors.

questions.prompt: Single responsibility is best understood as what?
questions.explanation: Cohesive responsibility matters more than arbitrary class size.

options.text: Only when no validation is needed
Readable construction with many optional settings

questions.explanation: A builder can organize construction choices and validate them.

questions.prompt: What should be in place before refactoring a pricing rule?

options.text: A second implementation of every getter

questions.explanation: Behavior tests detect accidental changes during restructuring.

questions.prompt: Does List.copyOf deeply freeze mutable element objects?

options.text: Only for lists of size one

questions.explanation: It copies the collection structure, not the internals of each element.

questions.prompt: What does dependency inversion encourage at a variable boundary?

options.text: Use static state for all collaborators
Instantiate every vendor class inside every method

questions.explanation: A focused contract lets higher-level policy avoid vendor details.
